# Adapter manifest corpus notices

These files are unmodified package-manager manifests collected on 2026-08-22 from public
repositories for compatibility testing. Each numbered directory names its GitHub owner and
repository; the retained manifest filename (and, for monorepos, the source path below) identifies
the source artifact. Copyright remains with the upstream authors. The selected repositories use
MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, ISC, or similarly permissive dual licenses; consult the linked repository's
LICENSE for the authoritative text.
